Unobtainable Unit

Overview

Trickster (Release) is a Secret Limited unit. He can only be obtained by evolving Trickster and his evolved form is only available from the Hollow World event.

Evolving

Trickster (Release) can be evolved from Trickster with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Trickster
x2 Thread of the Exile
x1 Soul Orb
x40 Soul Candy

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Active Skill: Kannonbiraki Benihime Aratame

Kisuke will buff his allies’ range by 20% and SPA by 10%. This ability is stackable with other buffs (except Priest (Heaven)'s Time Acceleration, but range buffs still stack), his ability cooldown is not global and is very useful for pretty much every mode making Kisuke very worth getting.

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

Trivia

  • His upgrades' costs were just the same as Paradox (Divine Sight).
